hook.name: UniswapV4Hook
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 buy-and-burn hook: buys (ETH->token) collect a 1.7% ETH fee into a burn pot; sells (token->ETH) collect a 1.7% token fee queued for burning. Every 20 swaps a buyback is signaled. Exact-output swaps are blocked. Liquidity additions are once-per-token, and sells are blocked in the same block as a buyback. Additionally, afterSwap has a tx.origin allowlist (deployer-controlled) that anyone can activate via superposition() to block sells for non-allowlisted addresses.
